newsitem.title: ITALY: HORSE RACING-DETTORI GUIDES SHANTOU TO WIN IN ITALY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DETTORI GUIDES SHANTOU TO WIN IN ITALY.

text.p: The John Gosden-Frankie Dettori team extended their golden season to San Siro, Milan, on Sunday where the combination landed a group double with Shantou and Leap For Joy.

The Gosden trained St Leger winner Shantou followed up his hard fought win in the world's oldest classic by powering three lengths clear of Sacrament, ridden by Walter Swinburn, as British horses ruled.
To further underscore the British dominance, Paul Cole's Strategic Choice took third some five and a half lengths behind the winner.

It had earlier been a similar story in the five-furlong Group Three Premio Omemoni in which Leap For Joy led a British cleansweep, heading home Brave Edge and Hever Golf Rose by a length and a quarter and a short head.
